name: Shield of Law
summary: Ward allies against attacks, possession, and chaotic magic.
description: Each warded creature gains +4 deflection AC, +4 resistance on saves, and spell resistance 25 against chaotic spells and spells from chaotic creatures. The ward blocks possession and mental influence as Protection from Chaos does. A chaotic creature that lands a melee hit on a warded target must make a Will save against this spell or be affected as by Slow.
target: one creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you
